notes.title: Kofi Quest - Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey! Today we bring you an update that fixes an important bug that prevented some players from progressing in the game. We also fixed some other minor issues.

Changelist:

Fixed bug that prevented the light foxes from destroying the spectral walls.
Modified alternative function for D-pad Up. It now selects all your units except Chai. The previous function is now part of the D-pad left and right alternative functions, which will select all the identical units before changing to the next group.
Fixed bug that prevented the cooldown from showing on the special skill buttons.
Fixed brigde in The Pond That prevented the players from crossing it and getting to a cave.
Fixed map error on The Dismal in the notebook.
Fixed buig that softlocked the game when attacking certain character in group.
Fixed duplicated duck.
Visual fixes in the character sheet of the new enemis from the last update.
Fixed two empty chests. Whoever had already opened them won't be able to open them again, but their contents weren't important (gold and consumable items).
Translation fixes.
Visual fixes in the new dungeons.

Thank you for your support and patience.

notes.title: The gamepad control is here! Big big update (1.0)
notes.notes:
Hi there mercebinaries! Today we bring a big update for Kofi Quest, with something widely asked, [b]the gamepad control![/b] Kofi Quest was designed to be played with a mouse and a keyboard, so in order to create a gamepad control that feels natural we decided to rethink the control system a little bit. If you still prefer playing with mouse and keyboard you can keep doing that the same way as before, but keep reading, because there are more surprises.

[b]New content![/b]

This update includes all the content made for the Nintendo Switch version. New dungeons, new items, new enemies and new friendships in a big sidequest that will take you to the different regions of the game unwrapping their deepest secrets.

[b]New languages![/b]

Now you can enjoy all of Kofi Quest's content with texts in Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese.

Besides all of that, you'll see tons of general improvements, performance optimizations and lots of fixes and added details. We hope you'll enjoy them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/f293846ca0fdac47a1bec2aeecf6a0505908475c.png[/img]

notes.title: Kofi Quest is coming to Nintendo Switch on August 25
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/a0b2b4c0a0de3070e6e0e836ca2380f20eccb649.png[/img]

Since this game was released on PC in 2020, we have been working hard on it listening to players and improving many aspects to reach the best possible version. Between 2020 and 2021 the game received numerous patches with corrections and improvements, but as some of you know, in parallel we were working on the long-awaited version for Nintendo Switch.

The Nintendo Switch version posed quite a few challenges for us, highlighting the optimization to obtain the best performance on the Nintendo console, the controller control, which was especially complicated to design and implement and which went through different phases as a demo for backers of Kickstarter and of course, the inclusion of new content such as dungeons, weapons, mechanics... so that this new version brings out the best in Kofi Quest.

The game that we originally published under the title of “Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD” [b]will be renamed solely “Kofi Quest” when it arrives on Nintendo Switch and will be available from August 25 on the eShop[/b].

In fact, at this point the game is already appearing in the Nintendo eShop, those interested can already add it to their wish list.

[b]All the news of the Switch version will be included in the Steam version through a free patch[/b], but this will not be done immediately, the same day of launch, because we have to do some previous revisions, but we will try to make it available as soon as possible.

eshop link: [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/kofi-quest-switch/]https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/kofi-quest-switch/[/url]

notes.title: Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD - Update 0.11.4
notes.notes:
Hi! We're back with a new update (0.11.4).

As you know, we are working on the Nintendo Switch version, so we have been making changes and improvements to the game for a long time. The idea is to include all of those improvements in one giant patch soon, but in the meantime, we've been able to include some of them in the current version of the game. [b]Including cloud save[/b]! We hope you like these fixes.

The changes that are included in the new update:

[b]Important changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cloud save.[/b]
[*] Fixed various game crashes.
[*] Cinematic improvements and new animations.
[*] Fixes music configuration that inmproves considerably the sound quality.
[*] Improved aim for ranged units. Now they will hit even moving targets. The Bent Bow still have a chance of throwing a bent arrow that will miss its target.
[/list]

[b]Temporary allies (those who help you only in certain quests)[/b]
[list]
[*] Added visual indicator if a temporary ally is left behind because you get out of the area where they help you.
[*] Fixed bug that caused some temporary allies to appear duplicated.
[*] Fixed autosave bug that allowed to keep certain temporary allies in areas outside of their assigned quest.
[*] Now temporary allies respawn right after a scene change if they were dead in the previous one (this avoids various bugs).
[/list]

[b]Minor changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed orc apprentice shaman's skill effect that wasn't applying correctly.
[*] Fixed bug upon exiting a game during a boss fight and loading another slot.
[*] Fixed bug that set infinite range to Kofi in the final boss battle.
[*] Fixed bug that allowed the use of the horn right before it was used by the cinematic at Paimon's castle.
[*] Fixed bug with Mr. Wisp if BRAT died while using the Will-o'-wisp skill.
[*] Fixed bug that could duplicate Mr. Wisp at certain scenes in the Dismal.
[*] Units can't die anymore if they receive damage while their HP are increasing due to the effect of a curative item.
[*] Removed incorrect "No effect" message when using an item on a character with Spectral body.
[*] Fixed bug that prevented non-controllable allies or enemies' skills from showing their icon and description.
[*] Fixed bug that spawned incorrect units after saving and loading the game at a specific moment in Paimon's castle.
[*] Fixed bug that made units unable to walk around certain trees and made them trip or get stuck while trying to walk through them.
[*] Fixed bug that made certain obstacles in Neighborwood to keep showing at advanced points of the game when they shouldn't be there anymore.
[*] Fixed bug that allowed the player to reach the first switch in the mole's quest without the mole's help.
[*] Fixed Morelia's health the first time you meet her.
[*] Fixed cracker's ranged attack.
[*] Fixed sounds that were cut abruptly in scene changes.
[*] Fixed bug that made Chai alert about an enemy attack while being healed on certain conditions.
[*] Fixed camera limits on scenes with wrong configuration.
[/list]

notes.title: Kofi Quest in 2021 - A big update is underway
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/564506c632bb248ecf6a9d445a4775a63871994e.png[/img]

Hey there! 2020 was a tough year for everyone, but even with some hardships we’ve been able to make great progress in Kofi Quest. We want to mention some of the announcements we’ve made to our backers in Kickstarter over these months. We’re focusing our efforts in the Nintendo Switch version, but all upgrades and changes will apply to the PC version too.

[h2][b]We have a PUBLISHER to release in Nintendo Switch![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/36523989eda626a7e1d4453da477bed6755b7293.jpg[/img]

We want to let you all know that after several months of meetings and interviews, we’ve finally reached an agreement AND WE NOW HAVE A PUBLISHER that will take care of our game in Nintendo Switch. We’re really excited about it because it’s undoubtedly big news for the project.

[h2][b]The Nintendo Switch Port - What's new?[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/33aca21e280b54ba9fadd2d846c105a36f52f236.jpg[/img]

What’ll be new in the Nintendo Switch version:
[list]
[*] The new controller system, which greatly changes the game experience.
[*] New content that will only be playable after the Switch release.
[*] New languages
[*] Many improvements and fixes (including all Steam fixes /patches /updates)
[/list]

[h2][b]The PC DEMO for the CONTROLLER system (backers only)[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/27936b70946adeacb781e342c4e8bc01f017e3fd.jpg[/img]

Over the past few months we’ve been hard at work improving the game to adapt it to Nintendo Switch, both in functionality and in performance. In December we published an exclusive demo for backers on Kickstarter that allows you to play with a controller to test our new system, going through some maps and allowing you to play with 7 different characters, as well as use some items and fight against enemies. Having released this demo is helping us to make the controller system even better (which will also be usable here on Steam when available).

[h2][b]Kofi Quest will be available with text in Chinese and Portuguese[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/bb7aa1c4bcbb11d6251508f39729092bbaaf7a69.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/8cafb0566d5fe8a6198024e7b0a4bada03bb8a27.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/f6ee7237f7ee61f48e48923eb0dd5a00bf127c36.jpg[/img]


Our game will include new languages, since they’ll be available since the launch of the Nintendo Switch version (at which point there will be a PC patch including the same new stuff). The game will include texts in Chinese and Portuguese. Unfortunately, we can’t include all the languages we’d like because our game is over 85,000 words, and due to that extensive script translating this content is hard work (and an elevated cost).  But even so, we will continue to try to include texts in new text languages in the future. 

[h2][b]The next Steam Update?[/b][/h2]

Right now it is difficult for us to continue uploading updates in the Steam version at the same time that we focus on the Switch version because there is a lot of risk of losing control.

So the game is launched on Switch we’ll release a big update on PC where you’ll get all the new stuff, such as the extra content, the controller support, new languages and many fixes and changes.

Best! ːsteamhappyː

Loftur Studio

notes.title: Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD - Update 0.11.0
notes.notes:
We're back with a new update (0.11.0). The changes that are included in the new update:

[h2]Quick Travel reimagined[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/b15cab67fb01d2c81938ce52e70fb02e7b390cb1.jpg[/img]

We’ve implemented a completely renewed Quick Travel system. Instead of having to go to a Save Point in order to travel to one of the few destination points, it’s now possible to travel from anywhere to any of the Save Points that you have already visited (unless it’s impossible to get there for narrative reasons).
[list]
[*] From now on, to quick travel you just have to open your map from the Pause menu or from the quick access in the lower right corner (M key) and select the save point to which you want to travel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/9f4313a8c88d62ee1eab08a9ead86675a0724fbc.jpg[/img]

[*] You will now keep the summoned units when quick travelling (unless you’re going back to the shelter).
[*] Hovering over any floppy disk on the map will show the name of the place where it is located.
[*] To help understand the interconnection between the different maps in the game, you can now use the arrows at the start and end of the maps to open previous or next maps.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/21b0283777604e186c77b5573d3dac68566c0412.jpg[/img]

[h2]Transport characters[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/efcea9110a605b4d5cca851a721c4d610c9202bd.jpg[/img]

Throughout the adventure you will have found characters who offer to take you to different points on the map, to make it compatible with the new Quick Travel system, we have relocated some of them to allow you to take some shortcuts where Quick Travel doesn’t reach.

Instead of offering you a list of destinations, you can see icons on the map so there is no doubt about the exact place you’ll be traveling to.

Between the Fast Travel and these friendly characters, no corner of the game shall remain unexplored.
 
[h2]Recover motivation[/h2]

At different moments in the story, there are cinematics that force some of your allies to disappear (because the situation requires it). When this happens Kofi will be given back the motivation points that cost to call them.

[list][*] If you make a Quick Travel to the shelter, where your units return to their usual tasks, you will also recover the corresponding motivation.[/list]

[h2]Losing motivation[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/c8af02ef1785c525cafe5ea6adbb83e6e8aee20d.jpg[/img]

At certain points in the game, there are characters that will help you temporarily and eventually become part of your army. During this temporary situation, these characters will reappear over and over again, without any cost of motivation. To balance this situation, from now on you will lose some motivation points when one of these temporary allies dies.

[h2]New Upgrade for the wallet[/h2]

Since the launch of the game, many players have asked us about a wallet upgrade, which until now could only reach 999 coins. Finally, we have added the possibility of obtaining a superior wallet, with a capacity of 3,000 coins. How do you get the new wallet to access new wealth? Well rubbing shoulders with the right people, of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/9d4af91d9c9a9b29f39463629fbd58fe9a57ff48.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Pro Weapons (Giant Sword, Dagger of the flame, Bow of the driven snow)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/8f31d68975ad0b02ff18fcc27fd5444e8c795f4e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/dba2a54cf17086682b9264a3ae5edda2b1068aee.jpg[/img]

The new wallet will give you access to some of the weapons in Grung's shop that were previously impossible to buy. These weapons had a merely narrative function (indeed, they were designed so that they could not be purchased). To avoid confusion, we have had to remove some of these items but we have programmed the rest so that you can buy and use them.

[h2]I won’t miss! (Elfa, right before missing a shot)[/h2]

We’ve already made corrections in the past to the aim of ranged units, this time we’ve fixed certain problems that ranged units had when shooting at moving targets.

[h2]Magical ice creams![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/043b98892511d0deec549ada8361e791e92586d9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/bb31710d828de0a73522bc3120722b7e4df60bf0.jpg[/img]

Summer arrives and with it the ice creams that keep us cool and with high HP. They say that there is a magical ice cream guy that goes around the world with his magical cart full of (magical) ice creams. If you meet a character with an ice cream in their hands, you are in luck. Talk to him so he can tell you where he last saw the ice cream guy. (Hint: don't use Quick Travel to find him, it's not really that fast and the ice cream guy will have plenty of time to go somewhere else.)

Other fixes:

[list]
[*] Adjusted some character stats (allies and enemies)
[*] Adjusted amount of gold in some chests and the gold that shopkeepers offer you for some items
[*] Kofi's face finally appears on maps when he is inside a cave or house
[*] After a Game Over or Mission Failed, you will get a small Motivation bonus if you were low on it.
[*] Corchel's quest can be completed at any point throughout the adventure (previously you could only complete it for a period of time within the adventure)
[*] Kofi tries to put himself in a visually favorable position when talking to an NPC
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD - Update 0.10.7
notes.notes:
We hope you are all well and safe. In the last few weeks we've had difficulties to work normally, but we have been able to make improvements based on your comments and feedback.

We're back with a new update (0.10.7). The changes that are included in the new update:

Cinematics:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with the facial expression system (mouth and eyes when characters talk and look to each other).
[*] Fixed bug that prevented the instructor from executing its animations the first time you met him.
[*] Fixed bug that caused Mr. Wisp and its summoner to not show up when you got out from the shepherd's house.
[*] Fixed sound in clock wipe transition that sometimes started playing too soon.
[*] In the bullseye minigame Kofi won't turn red when getting hit by an arrow if the bullseye is being held up.
[*] Added visual effect when Pal uses the teleporter in the instructor's house.
[*] NPCs who tell random sentences won't say the same one twice in a row. Now go talk to everyone.
[*] Added animation to Morelia in her first appearance to make clear that she's injured/tired.
[/list]

Read sign posts:
[list]
[*] Now they behave like NPCs when you talk to them, the action will stop and will resume once the dialog is over.
[/list]

Zoom:
[list]
[*] The game will restore the camera zoom level that the player had once a cinematic ends.
[/list]

Kofi's (and others') console:
[list]
[*] The characters will only press buttons during the game (not in the menu nor the victory screen).
[*] The rival will only use skills during the game (not in the menu nor the victory screen).
[*] The rival won't use skills while the player's using one.
[/list]

Visual:
[list]
[*] When interacting with a house, the action icon will show over the door instead of showing over the center of the house.
[/list]

Functional:
[list]
[*] Adjusted contents of chests in certain buggy dungeon.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.10.0 - Tactical mode is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/de5a764ec0bfb417af5a193c4cda7ab047b01c82.jpg[/img]

Greetings! Those of you who have been following Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD since launch will know that we’ve been constantly working on upgrades and fixes. There have been over 20 updates since the game was launched about a month and a half ago, but on this occasion we’re presenting an update that’s quite more interesting.

We’re accepting your opinions to keep Kofi Quest constantly improving. You’re helping us a lot from our Discord server, and thanks to you the game is more solid and complete with each update.

[h1][b]Patch Notes of version 0.10.0[/b][/h1]

[h3]Important changes[/h3]
[list][*] New Tactical Mode. If you activate the tactical mode, you’ll be able to command your army while the combat flows in slow motion. This option has been among the most requested by players. Press the Space button to toggle the tactical mode.

[previewyoutube=bySoDylR1xg;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] There’s been a revamp to the troop movement and formation system. Units will fill the space differently, aiding the movement of bigger groups.

[*] Leader characters (like Kofi and Chai) cannot be pushed by other allies, reducing the possibility of them falling over edges.

[*] New access keys next to the monitor. There are now shortcuts to the equipment window, the inventory organizer and the maps window. Moreover, new hotkeys have been added for these shortcuts:
M - Opens the maps window
J - Opens the inventory organizer
K - Opens the equipment window
L - Focuses camera on Chai’s flag

[*] Now you can see the full stats of the equipped weapons, which makes it easier to compare weapons that are equipped with those in the inventory.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Issues with the Achievement system.
[*] Artillery towers (bombs). Fixed bugs related to the control of towers by the Orc Engineer.
[*] Fixed some visual issues related to water shores and bridges when they break or go up or down.
[*] Fixed issue that showed in empty shop slots in some situations.
[*] Revised some numerical values related to prices in some shops.
[*] Fixed a number of minor bugs and made small performance upgrades.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/32f1296bbba8b093121d077a77c1c4f7215b5936.png[/img]

We still want to keep improving the game, so we will keep making frequent updates with their corresponding Patch Notes.

If you want to join our community and report issues you find or share suggestions, please join our Kofi Quest Discord server. You’re more than welcome :)

We’re keeping at it!

notes.notes:
We're back with a new update (0.9.23). After the previous fixes that we've been publishing since launch, we added some new and interesting ones. The changes that are included in the new update:[list]
[*]Improved the route calculation of the flying units so they don't fall down pits too often.
[*]Fixed bug that caused shooters to hit their allies too often.
[*]Stability improvements.
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/32f1296bbba8b093121d077a77c1c4f7215b5936.png[/img]

After more than 4 years of work, finally, the first version of Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD is available on Steam. We encourage you to try our humble game, that we’ve made with endless care and being a small team of five people.

Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD is a not-so-serious adventure that brings together mechanics from Action RPG and RTS games. You’ll control Kofi, a weak, lazy and unlucky video game character that will be followed by a group of interesting (and pathetic) characters aiding him to live a great adventure.

[previewyoutube=0oKxRZwUzrY;full][/previewyoutube]

This project started back in 2015, and comes from the animated episodes of Kofi, which we started in 2014 and which you can watch on YouTube for free. If you’re interested in the world of Kofi, be advised that the events in the video game take place after the animated webseries.

[b]What does this game offer?[/b]

[list]
[*]  RTS troop control. Real-time group management. Control your own army.
[*] Captains with special skills.
[*]  Find or buy weapons and equipment that allows you to improve your characters; multiple enemies with different qualities: find the best strategy to win.
[*]  An adventure full of humor and exciting all the same that talks about a beginner adventurer’s road to self-improvement, and the importance of teamwork. With loads of surreal situations and unforgettable characters.
[*]  Explore a big map with different environments (forests, houses, caves, mountains, water areas…). Find chests with unique weapons, funny side quests or simply discover new details about Kofi's world through characters’ stories or written texts.
[*]  More than 60 different enemies.
[*] Interaction with characters or elements of the stage. Many of the elements of the stage can be selected or destroyed (bushes, rocks…).
[*]  Fully functional game console. You can get some retro games to play if you can find them at sidequests.
[*]  Thousands of voiced lines for each language (English and Spanish).
[/list]

Important! Please, help us make Kofi Quest known so it can become a better game.

We’re a small team. We don’t work with a publishing company, we publish our game completely independently with the only support of the players. We’ve needed many years to build the Kofi universe and we’ll still be here to improve it and fix any problems you may encounter.

Please, if you find any kind of issue with the game, don’t hesitate to contact us. You have our word that we care and we’ll get to it. For us, the most important thing is that everyone has a good experience and that you all enjoy the Kofi universe.

If you liked the game, and you can help us spread the word about our work, we’ll be very grateful.

Thank you all for your patience and support! Without you, this wouldn’t have been possible.

notes.title: Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD will hit Steam the 28th of January
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/32f1296bbba8b093121d077a77c1c4f7215b5936.png[/img]

Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD will finally be available on Steam the 28th of January 2020 at 12:00am PST (UTC-8) for Windows systems. We’re really excited about it. [b]Please, add the game to your Steam wishlist[/b] to stay in the loop!

[h3]Interesting things about the launch that should be kept in mind[/h3]
Even though the official launch date is January 28th, some of the Kickstarter backers (pre-launch access backers) are playing right now. We’re really excited to have people finally playing it.

The most important part is to make it known that we intend to keep on working on the game, so although we hope you really enjoy the experience we’ve been preparing for you for years, we also want to make it clear that we’ll keep on fixing possible errors and improving the game experience even after launch.

See you very soon!

notes.title: Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD - Final calendar
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/2107aa0912c36957946a4f0f377d57f3107d5ab7.png[/img]

What’s up? In Loftur Studio we’re still working tirelessly in the development of Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD. The past few months have been a great opportunity to improve the product a great deal, as well as to lay the foundations for our future plans of launching the game for Nintendo Switch.

[h1][b]Important! Development updates 2019[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/29aaf8d263681256790bdbdbd1cc0472f5a19ed8.png[/img]

[list][*] [b]Optimization[/b]. We’ve made the preliminary revisions aimed at the future port to Nintendo Switch, such as a first layer of optimization (pretty important), necessary changes in the internal structure of the game and first steps in controller handling (keep in mind that this game was originally designed to be played with a keyboard and mouse, so there’s work to be done, and we want to do it right).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/4e0c9195860b01be6d5c7445bb3460f070536730.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Kickstarter stretch goals[/b]. As promised in the stretch goals, we’ve developed new minigames and, in addition, we’ve worked in the [b]secret combat units[/b]. On top of the playable characters you’ll be able to find in the main story, there will be some secret, optional ones, and they will all have their own unique narrative context.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/d636c62a31c0e9add7e39f59385c8840cfde38d0.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Important improvements in the game experience[/b]. Thanks to the Kickstarter backers giving us more development time, we’ve taken the opportunity to implement new features that improve the game experience, taking on some design parts that could be improved from another angle and polishing content. For some necessary improvements [b]we’ve rewrite important segments of the code from scratch[/b]. We've invested time, but we're now more solid and really excited about the results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/8edd32f4e60d4f1bb9bf8050e056a9239b867b6d.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Bug correction[/b]. As we always say, there’s very few of us in the team and it’s hard to control such a big project. The bug correction is a constant fight and we’ve made incredible progress in it, although it’ll remain something we keep working on before, during and after launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/e6075db2e3620ddcee080fcff62821ff1bca117b.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]The final calendar[/h1]

At this point, we’re going to present our final plan for development and launch. With all the changes this project has been through and how much it’s evolved along its several years of development, we’ve discussed what’d be the launch period where we can guarantee the 1.0 version that we want to offer you. We also have to prepare a better advertising campaign for all those press professionals who want to give our game a try.

Therefore, the final calendar will be as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/703c7552a25ea674b7ee8394a99523c3d51d8996.jpg[/img]

After many twists and turns and improvements, we’re finally satisfied with the result and ready to stop lengthening the project, but we need more time to finish and review all the changes done over this year with all the guarantees.

We also want to prepare some good press materials. After the Kickstarter campaign, we had several conversations with publishers interested in the game, and that meant changes in schedule and content, but we eventually reached no agreements and have decided to go independently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31257282/6bbe19756aca8c845a4a859e4f9db9c8273afe69.jpg[/img]

The next 28th of November we’ll publish a backers-only update with some gameplay footage. In other platforms, we’ll publish more news in December.

We keep working.

Cheers,

Loftur Studio Team

notes.title: Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD will launch a Kickstarter campaign this April.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/a351e2e7ccdf4154ed787e5c636e7a253009698f.jpg[/img]

After some events that the Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD project has gone through behind the scenes, we at Loftur Studio have decided to launch a Kickstarter campaign for it, which will begin by the end of April.

We have been developing Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD for over three years. We have learned a lot, much has happened and we have been constantly working, day after day. Our game is in a very advanced stage, but we’re a very small team and we still find many obstacles that prevent us from finishing the game in the desired conditions, and from reaching higher goals with it.

Bringing the game over to Nintendo Switch (and other consoles) is a constant request amongst players. We want to work on an adaptation of the controls for gamepad and, later on, make a port for Nintendo Switch, with all the work that implies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/96bbd60eb7855eb058baf1e9a12d25f0bebad8d6.png[/img]

We also want to work more in our social networks and open doors for players to be able to participate more in the decision making of some of the content. We have prepared the campaign with much dedication, with interesting rewards and possible Stretch Goals that could make a much better game if we reach them.

The campaign starting date will be announced next week, and we will start showing everything new that we’ve prepared for it.

Please, stay tuned in our social networks.

notes.title: Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD dev diary 2.21.19
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/54ad642014f4d033434ece8828ff4e1391b5d641.png[/img]

The development of Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD keeps progressing day after day. Mid-2018, a decision was made to expand and improve the project by lengthening its development time, and that period of extra work brings us to today.

Our aim was to finish the game by early 2019 and, once an acceptable point of development had been reached, find an appropriate launch date.

We have been working very hard over the past few months to take the game to a good development point and we’re satisfied with the reached goals.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/b83b5d90e72d98ac687ff8d30f8b679026e1bd45.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/39e909fc043f9f3947a593cb9c5d9ffd905b7f79.png[/img]

The scene construction, art, script, soundtrack and voice acting are all finished.

In its implementation, the game is done and it can be played from beginning to end, but there are still some minor errors popping up, as well as ideas of necessary improvements to offer a good experience, especially related to the cinematic aspects of the game, the player’s interaction with the environment and the overall gameplay mechanics. This is a point where we always find new ways of improvement every time we go over games from real players with different gaming profiles and amount of experience.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/a9bde37722436d0c0d0f50e53be043b2518d9526.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/61727d2e35d9db9f10013f033c853b728501a7bc.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/31731a6bd2b1cabb5c7c5b5e24186eda2f575273.gif[/img]

After suffering some delays in 2018, our objective is for the next launch date announcement to be definitive, which is why we’ll announce said date soon, working hard every day to make it as soon as possible.

Seeing how well accepted the story trailer from last month was, we’re planning on recording new scenes to show you a new video.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/81710985ed98614306b3347b61fc0414f862ff94.png[/img]

notes.title: Comienzos de 2019 + Fecha del tráiler narrativo + Sorteo
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/f7ecf31bc8de09c07dd33b0bb61b2c3eabaed6a7.jpg[/img]

Desde Loftur Studio hemos decidido modificar el campo que especifica el periodo de lanzamiento en Steam pasando de “Enero de 2019” a “Comienzos de 2019”. Aunque seguimos con nuestro objetivo en mente de lanzar el videojuego a finales de enero, el calendario de lanzamientos de juegos está saturado y llegados a este punto queremos dejar una puerta abierta a un posible pequeño cambio si con ello pudiéramos conseguir una fecha de lanzamiento más adecuada para Kofi, aunque nuestros planes de trabajo se mantienen tal y como estaban hasta ahora.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/c7a06a47973b155b171058615e3e36c752387b39.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/36c2f858b521c097f2feba4c94d0cdfc55f66b20.jpg[/img]

Además de eso, recientemente hemos tenido la oportunidad de llevar Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD a tres eventos en España, en los que muchos jugadores han podido probar una demo con cierto nivel de acabado.

Hemos recibido impresiones, consejos y propuestas no sólo de jugadores, sino también de profesionales del sector como miembros de la prensa y otros desarrolladores, y aunque nos es imposible trabajar en todas esas propuestas de forma inmediata, sí hemos visto adecuado ponernos manos a la obra con algunas de ellas para de incluirlas en la primera versión. Dejaremos otras propuestas interesantes para incluirlas pasado el lanzamiento.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/9413b88c1605d2f6ebd5935930cde2efaa5698a8.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/44a36d4c4f9ce4ad6d4cba05a666645227ce2aed.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/e9bee5f40568f6507b6ecfa90a7581dfbc9e659f.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/c23c47c44100d41e52581c958d0252aa2d5dfa91.jpg[/img]

Nuevamente, agradecemos la paciencia de los que estáis siguiendo nuestro primer proyecto. Seguimos trabajando muy duramente y estamos muy emocionados por cómo está quedando la primera versión y tenemos muchas ganas de que podáis disfrutar de Kofi en videojuego. Nos sentimos muy bien por haber decidido posponer el juego desde su fecha de lanzamiento original de julio de 2018 porque lo que tenemos ahora es muy diferente a lo que habríamos publicado entonces y todos los que habéis podido probarlo en los eventos y ferias nos habéis transmitido que habéis notado mucho las mejoras. Gracias por vuestro apoyo, por vuestros ánimos y por disfrutar con Kofi Quest.

[b]Nuevo tráiler el 4 de enero[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/c1ce6ae0c6ad5df3223db2225770685d96abf7fb.jpg[/img]

El viernes 4 de enero publicaremos un tráiler muy especial: [b]el tráiler narrativo[/b]. En este vídeo mostraremos por fin algunas frases interpretadas por el equipo de actores de voz de Kofi para que podáis ver cómo se han integrado en el juego.

Estamos ilusionados porque con este vídeo podremos mostrar una cara de Kofi Quest más fiel al resultado final en comparación con todo lo mostrado hasta ahora.

El tráiler se subirá en inglés en el canal de Youtube de Loftur Studio y también en español en el canal de Youtube de Kofi (la serie). Ambos vídeos se publicarán también aquí en Steam.

[b]Bonus: Sorteo especial muy pronto[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/ec5c154b47f778c9934aa2496401b63dbbc4cb04.jpg[/img]

Como bonus, deciros que se avecina un sorteo muy especial. A todos aquellos que uséis Twitter, os pedimos estar atentos a nuestra cuenta de [url=http://www.twitter.com/kofiquest]@kofiquest[/url], pues en breve iniciaremos un sorteo especial relacionado con Kofi para agradecer vuestro apoyo (y porque es Navidad, demonios). Cuando llegue el día lo anunciaremos también aquí en Steam.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/a1d0c59d47c782cddc565995e346ca3b6fbc2992.gif[/img]

notes.title: Kofi Webseries - Season 1 (Complete)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31257282/cf96e764e7fcef8d741741e352d6b6f719f03de3.png[/img]

Hi! We're back with some new Kofi animations. Here's the complete first season. This is just the beginning!

Kofi is a character from an RPG game. He spends his days lazing around. He goes to his instructor to ask for help improving and gets gifted with a summoning skill.

Kofi’s summon’s name is Lime, a slime that happens to have zero motivation and be even lazier than him, and that would rather nest himself in the couch in a valiant attempt at doing nothing together than help him progress.

In the timeline of the Kofi universe, the first three seasons of the animated series take place right before Kofi Quest: Alpha MOD.

Please, enjoy.


[h1]KOFI SERIES SEASON 1[/h1]

[/list]
